segments.name: Power generation
segments.description: Designs and develops fuel-agnostic power generators for stationary and mobile applications and provides R&D services, targeting datacenter, commercial, industrial and defense sectors.
segments.evidence: Hyliion Holdings Corp. is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, with research and development ("R&D") facilities in Cincinnati, Ohio, that designs and develops power generators for stationary and mobile applications and provides R&D services.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling KARNO Power Modules and from R&D services performed under contracts with the United States government.
revenueModel.evidence: Under the agreement, the Company will provide R&D services through July 2026 with an option to extend through July 2027, including design reviews, simulations, and reporting.

changes.text: In recent years the company wound down its powertrain operations and shifted focus to the KARNO Power Module.
changes.evidence: After the previously-announced wind down of our powertrain operations, we shifted our focus to the development and commercialization of the KARNO Power Module as a standalone product targeting power generation and e-mobility markets, and related R&D services that we have undertaken pursuant to contracts with the United States government.
